propositions: A durable append-only NDJSON snapshot store is needed to persist point-in-time code-health metrics (coverage %, complexity, clone count) so their history accrues across CI runs.
The snapshot file must be stored at .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (not reports/) and tracked in git via a !-negation in .gitignore so the series actually persists and syncs.
write_snapshot(dict) appends a timestamped record to the NDJSON file and read_snapshots(since,until) yields in-range records for trend analysis.
Malformed or truncated NDJSON lines are skipped without raising an exception; the reader returns only valid records.
Unit tests verify round-trip write/read within date range, out-of-range exclusion, and graceful handling of corrupt lines without raising.
